DIFFERENTIAL DIAGNOSES OF PITYRIASIS ROSEA
Differential Diagnoses
- Secondary syphilis
- Exanthematic or pityriasis rosea-like drug eruptions
- Lichen planus
- Guttate psoriasis
- Tinea corporis
- Tinea versicolor
- Seborrhoeic dermatitis
- Viral exanthems
- Pityriasis lichenoides chronica
Complications
- None
